task.description:
Mark PD-05 as RELEASED and update all documentation.

1. Update `docs/status/requirement_status.json`: set PD-05 status to `RELEASED`.
2. Update `CHANGELOG.md`: add an entry for PD-05 (Node types) under the current date / Stage 2 section. Include:
   - Updated NodeType enum: HUMAN_TASK (was USER_TASK), TIMER (was SCRIPT_TASK), plus START, END, SERVICE_TASK, EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY, PARALLEL_GATEWAY
   - New `validateNodeAttributes()` pure function in graph.zig
   - New optional `attributes` field on GraphNode struct
   - Per-type mandatory attribute validation at definition-save time:
     * HUMAN_TASK: requires `role` (non-empty string)
     * SERVICE_TASK: requires `endpoint` (non-empty string) and `timeout_ms` (1..300000)
     * TIMER: requires `duration_iso8601` (valid ISO 8601 duration; P0D accepted)
   - Attribute violations surface as HTTP 422 with violation codes
3. Call `fn:update-requirement-status` and `fn:update-changelog` per FUNCTIONS.md.
acceptance_criteria: PD-05 status is RELEASED in docs/status/requirement_status.json
CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing PD-05 changes including the NodeType rename
No other requirement statuses are modified

result.summary: Updated PD-05 status to RELEASED in docs/status/requirement_status.json; added PD-05 changelog entry under Stage 2 in CHANGELOG.md
